category_title: Students in conflict with authoritarian teachers over classroom rules
minimal_context: The student is entering the ESL class and is instructed to take out a book and a pencil.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Take out a book.

STUDENT: (Joking around) Why?

TUTOR: Take out a pencil.

STUDENT: Why?

TUTOR: Please just follow the instructions.

STUDENT: (Insults the teacher) I'm leaving. (Leaves the classroom without permission)

options.A: Ask the students to choose their own creative projects based on their strengths and interests.
options.B: Conduct orientation seminars at the beginning of the school year for the ESL students.
options.C: Emphasize mastery goals by valuing personal improvement and mastery of the ESL class tasks.
options.D: Hold an initial discussion where students name forms of literacy on sticky notes for a poster.
